messages.subject: Software Sustainability Institute lends a hand to Distance software development and maintenance
parts:
In the second half of 2014, the ‘Distance group’ at St. Andrews received advice and guidance from the Software Sustainability Institute. As their name suggests, the remit of this group is to aide in extending the longevity (and utility) of software created in a non-commercial environment.

Have a look at the description of the SSI intervention described in a blog at the SSI website. Speaking from experience, I can recommend the expertise that SSI brings to an examination of software development and maintenance. If you have software for which you or your group is responsible, have a look at the training and assistance offered by SSI.

​
